entities.name: Allyl bromide
observations: Decoded as CH2=CH–CH2Br; acts as the allylic electrophile in the proposed SN2 substitution.

entities.name: 4-bromo-2,5-difluorophenol
observations: Decoded as a bromodifluorophenol represented by Oc1cc(F)c(F)cc1Br; phenolic oxygen is the nucleophilic site.

entities.name: Allyl 4-bromo-2,5-difluorophenyl ether
observations: Probable major product from O-allylation; interpretable SMILES: C=CCOc1cc(F)c(F)cc1Br.

entities.name: Williamson ether synthesis
observations: Potassium carbonate-mediated O-alkylation of the difluorobromophenol with allyl bromide is the likely reaction class.

entities.name: K2CO3 in DMF/ether
observations: Dip potassium carbonate is the base; dimethylformamide and diethyl ether are listed as reaction-medium components.
